englishDefinition: To change or damage something secretly, especially in order to get a wrong result.
example: An investigator discovered that somebody had tampered with the records.
examplePersian: بازرس دریافت که کسی سوابق را دستکاری کرده است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Want very much to achieve something.
example: Many graduates aspire to work in the health service.
examplePersian: بسیاری از فارغ‌التحصیلان آرزوی کار در نظام سلامت را دارند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A burrow is a hole dug in the ground where an animal such as a rabbit lives.
example: The rabbit disappeared into its burrow as soon as the dog appeared.
examplePersian: به‌محض پیدا شدن سگ، خرگوش در لانه زیرزمینی‌اش ناپدید شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The process of developing a skill, a quality or an area of land over time.
example: The cultivation of rare plants has become a profitable business.
examplePersian: پرورش گیاهان کمیاب به کسب‌وکاری پرسود تبدیل شده است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: At the time that was expected or planned, as it should be.
example: The form was duly completed and returned within the week.
examplePersian: فرم به‌موقع تکمیل و ظرف یک هفته بازگردانده شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A circular movement of water or air, in the opposite direction to the main flow.
example: A small eddy of water turned the leaves in a slow circle.
examplePersian: گرداب کوچکی از آب برگ‌ها را آرام در دایره چرخاند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Accessory added to a machine or a tool.
example: These lights are modern fittings for an old house.
examplePersian: این چراغ‌ها چراغ‌های مدرنی برای خانه‌ای قدیمی هستند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To flow out suddenly and in large amounts.
example: Water gushed from the broken pipe and flooded the basement.
examplePersian: آب از لوله شکسته به‌شدت بیرون ریخت و زیرزمین را غرق کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To perform or deal with something using whatever is available at the time.
example: When the microphone failed, the musicians improvised for ten minutes.
examplePersian: هنگام خرابی میکروفون، نوازندگان ده دقیقه بداهه‌پردازی کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A person who is not a specialist in a subject and therefore talks about it in simple terms.
example: The guide was written in plain language so that a layman could follow it.
examplePersian: راهنما به زبان ساده نوشته شده بود تا یک غیرمتخصص هم بتواند آن را دنبال کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Very ordinary and dull, so that it lacks any interest or excitement.
example: The report spends twelve pages on mundane details that nobody will read.
examplePersian: گزارش دوازده صفحه را صرف جزئیات پیش‌پایه‌ای می‌کند که هیچ‌کس نخواهد خواند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To make a decision, law or result officially invalid.
example: The new ruling nullified decades of legal precedent.
examplePersian: رأی جدید دهه‌ها سابقهٔ حقوقی را باطل کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Slanting, or at an angle and not straight or upright.
example: Afternoon sunlight reached the floor at an oblique angle.
examplePersian: نور بعدازظهر با زاویه‌ای مورب به کف رسید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The state of being the father of a particular child.
example: He acknowledged paternity but denied joint custody.
examplePersian: او پدر بودن کودک را پذیرفت اما نگهداری مشترک را رد کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To collect the crops of a field, or to obtain something as a result of effort.
example: The new irrigation system allowed farmers to reap two harvests a year.
examplePersian: سامانه آبیاری جدید به کشاورزان اجازه داد سالی دو بار محصول برداشت کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To guess or form an opinion about something without having enough facts to be sure.
example: Analysts can only speculate about the cause of the sudden collapse.
examplePersian: تحلیلگران تنها می‌توانند درباره‌ی علت فروپاشی ناگهانی گمان بزنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To melt, or to cause to melt, when the temperature rises.
persianMeaning: باز شدن یا آب شدن با گرم شدن هوا
example: Frozen pipes began to thaw once the heating came back on.
examplePersian: لوله‌های یخ‌زده با روشن شدن دوباره گرما کم‌کم آب شدند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Express an idea clearly in words.
example: She articulated her concerns to the committee in two minutes.
examplePersian: او نگرانی‌هایش را در دو دقیقه به‌روشنی بیان کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A brood is a group of young birds or insects born at the same time.
example: The hen sat on her brood for three weeks without leaving the nest.
examplePersian: مرغ ماده سه هفته بدون ترک لانه روی نسل جوجه‌هایش ماند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To chant means to shout the same words again and again.
example: Supporters chanted the name of the striker throughout the second half.
examplePersian: هواداران در تمام نیمه دوم نام مهاجم را بارها فریاد زدند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Careful not to attract attention or to reveal private information.
example: She was discreet about the interview until the results were published.
examplePersian: او تا زمان انتشار نتایج، درباره مصاحبه چیزی نگفت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A purposeful activity that needs effort to achieve.
example: The project was a determined endeavour to protect the river.
examplePersian: این پروژه تلاشی مصممانه برای حفاظت از رودخانه بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To throw something with force.
example: He would fling the empty box into the bin whenever he was annoyed.
examplePersian: هر وقت ناراحت می‌شد جعبه خالی را به داخل سطل زباله پرتاب می‌کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Pleasant, friendly and easy to talk to.
example: The new landlord was extremely genial and answered every question politely.
examplePersian: صاحب‌خانهٔ جدید بسیار خوش‌برخورد بود و به هر پرسشی با ادب پاسخ داد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To live in large numbers in a place, especially as a pest.
example: Old timber is often infested with beetles and woodworm.
examplePersian: الوار قدیمی اغلب مورچه و سوسک چوب‌خوار آلوده می‌شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Unwilling to do something, because you do not want to or you are not ready to.
example: I am loth to spend so much money on something so ordinary.
examplePersian: من تمایلی ندارم این‌قدر پول برای چیزی چنین معمولی خرج کنم.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To gather together, usually in order to do something that is needed.
example: Few volunteers mustered after the storm, so the repair work went slowly.
examplePersian: پس از طوفان داوطلبان اندکی هم‌آوردند، بنابراین کار تعمیرات کند پیش رفت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The action of denying that something is true, or of saying that it does not exist.
example: The report is not a simple negation of everything the critics said.
examplePersian: این گزارش نفی سادهٔ همهٔ سخنان منتقدان نیست.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To force someone out of a position of power or competition.
persianMeaning: برکنار کردن؛ از مقام خود کنار زدن
example: The board ousted the chief executive after the audit.
examplePersian: هیئت‌مدیره پس از حسابرسی مدیرعامل را برکنار کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To pass into and come through a surface or material.
persianMeaning: نفوذ کردن؛ درون چیزی راه یافتن
example: Sunlight barely penetrates the dense forest canopy.
examplePersian: نور خورشید به‌سختی از پوشش متراکم جنگل نفوذ می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: بلیت یا کوپن را به کالا یا پول آن تبدیل کردن
englishDefinition: To exchange a ticket or a voucher for the goods or money that it is worth.
example: Customers can redeem the voucher for a free ticket before the end of June.
examplePersian: مشتریان می‌توانند تا پایان ژوئن کوپن را با یک بلیت رایگان معاوضه کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A man who is respected as a leader in national or international affairs.
example: Churchill was a respected statesman who shaped world politics after the war.
examplePersian: چرچیل مرد دولتی محترمی بود که پس از جنگ سیاست جهان را شکل داد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Quick to become upset or offended by criticism.
example: He is touchy about his accent whenever the topic comes up.
examplePersian: هر وقت این موضوع مطرح شود، نسبت به لهجه‌اش زودرنج می‌شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Make pain or a serious problem less severe.
example: The new treatment alleviates the symptoms but does not cure the disease.
examplePersian: درمان جدید علائم را کاهش می‌دهد اما بیماری را درمان نمی‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Wash yourself in water, or swim.
example: She bathed in the sea every morning during July.
examplePersian: او هر صبح ژوئیه در درایا شنا می‌کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A cavity is a hollow space inside a tooth that can cause serious pain.
example: A sweet diet increases the risk of a cavity in young children.
examplePersian: رژیم شیرین خطر ایجاد حفره در دندان کودکان را افزایش می‌دهد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To refuse to obey a rule, a law or a person in authority.
example: The officer defied the order to leave the border area.
examplePersian: آن افسر فرمان ترک منطقه مرزی را نادیده گرفت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To officially register as a student or member.
example: Thousands of students enrolled in the online course.
examplePersian: هزاران دانشجو در دوره آنلاین ثبت‌نام کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To lose something as a result of your own action.
example: Distracted drivers who use phones forfeit their licences.
examplePersian: رانندگان حواس‌پرتی که از تلفن استفاده می‌کنند گواهینامه خود را از دست می‌دهند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To provoke a person or an animal into reacting or moving.
example: The interviewer goaded the witness into changing her story.
examplePersian: مصاحبه‌کننده شاهد را تحریک کرد که روایتش را تغییر دهد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To catch fire, or to set something on fire.
example: Dry grass can ignite within seconds of a spark.
examplePersian: علف خشک می‌تواند در چند ثانیه پس از جرقه آتش بگیرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A place where somebody can stay for a short time, usually in return for money.
example: The cost of lodging in the city centre has risen sharply in recent years.
examplePersian: هزینهٔ اقامت موقت در مرکز شهر در سال‌های اخیر به‌شدت افزایش یافته است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Shockingly wrong or cruel, and far beyond what anybody would accept.
example: The proposal was monstrous, and the public refused to accept it at all.
examplePersian: پیشنهاد فاجعه‌بار بود و مردم آن را به‌هیچ‌وجه نپذیرفتند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A long-lasting anxiety disorder in which a person feels fear for no clear reason.
example: She was treated for a mild neurosis that left her unable to work.
examplePersian: او برای نوروزی خفیف درمان شد که او را از کار بازداشته بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The keeping of a religious rule, festival or traditional custom.
persianMeaning: رعایت؛ پایبندی به آیین یا سنت
example: The observance of the fast lasts for a whole month.
examplePersian: رعایت روزه یک ماه کامل طول می‌کشد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: غالب بودن، روی کار بودن، چیره شدن
englishDefinition: To exist or be accepted as the normal or dominant state in a place or time.
example: In the following decade, coastal cities prevailed over rural districts.
examplePersian: در دهه بعد، شهرهای ساحلی بر نواحی روستایی غلبه کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Continuing firmly and without mercy, and impossible to stop or satisfy.
example: Relentless pressure from competitors forced the firm to change.
examplePersian: فشار بی‌وقفه رقبا شرکت را ناچار به تغییر کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A smaller group formed from a larger committee to deal with one specific task.
example: A subcommittee will review the proposal before the full vote.
examplePersian: یک کمیته‌ی فرعی پیش از رأی‌گیری کامل پیشنهاد را بررسی خواهد کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To go beyond ordinary limits or rise above something.
persianMeaning: فراتر رفتن از حدهای معمول؛ برتری بر چیزی
example: The power of music transcends language and nationality.
examplePersian: قدرت موسیقی فراتر از زبان و ملیت است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Make someone aware of something, often for the first time.
example: The brochure acquaints visitors with the history of the building.
examplePersian: این بروشور بازدیدکنندگان را با تاریخ ساختمان آشنا می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A small flat with one room that serves as bedroom and living room.
example: She lives in a rented bedsit near the university.
examplePersian: او در یک یک‌نفره‌نشینی اجاره‌ای نزدیک دانشگاه زندگی می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A cellar is an underground room used for storage, often for wine.
example: The family keeps potatoes in the cellar through the winter.
examplePersian: خانواده در تمام زمستان سیب‌زمینی را در زیرزمین نگه می‌دارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To be a sign that shows that something is true or exists.
example: A red cross denotes a hospital in most countries.
examplePersian: در بیشتر کشورها، صلیب سرخ نشانه بیمارستان است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: Continuing for a very long time or for ever.
example: Her everlasting gratitude to her teachers shaped her career.
examplePersian: سپاس بی‌پایان او از معلمانش مسیر شغلی‌اش را شکل داد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: وجه و جنبه از یک موضوع
englishDefinition: One side or aspect of something complicated.
example: This last point is only one facet of the problem.
examplePersian: این نکته پایانی تنها یکی از جنبه‌های مشکل است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: A building where harvested grain is stored.
example: The old granary is now used as a museum of local farming history.
examplePersian: انبار غله قدیمی اکنون به‌عنوان موزه‌ای از تاریخ کشاورزی محلی استفاده می‌شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Very clever and inventive, especially as a solution to a problem.
example: An ingenious device turns the waste heat from the engine into hot water.
examplePersian: دستگاهی ابداعی گرمای اتلافی موتور را به آب گرم تبدیل می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Taking a long time and demanding a lot of slow, tiring physical effort.
example: The restoration of the old building was a slow and laborious process.
examplePersian: بازسازی ساختمان قدیمی فرایندی کند و پرزحمت بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A deep feeling of sadness that lasts a long time and is not easily forgotten.
example: The old photographs filled her with a quiet melancholy for weeks.
examplePersian: عکس‌های قدیمی او را هفته‌ها در اندوهی آرام فرو برد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A very small detail of behaviour or language that shows careful social judgement.
example: Diplomats are trained to observe every nicety of social behaviour.
examplePersian: دیپلمات‌ها آموزش می‌بینند تا هر ظرافت رفتار اجتماعی را بسنجند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A sign that suggests that something good or bad is coming.
example: The empty nest was treated as an omen of the family's decline.
examplePersian: لانهٔ خالی نشانهٔ افول خانواده به شمار می‌رفت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Concerned with how the body and its organs actually work.
example: The drug affects the physiological response of the brain.
examplePersian: این دارو بر پاسخ فیزیولوژیک مغز اثر می‌گذارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: A small part that remains after the rest has disappeared or been used.
example: A single remnant of the forest still shelters rare plants.
examplePersian: تنها بقایای کوچک آن جنگل هنوز میزبان گیاهان کمیاب است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A very small strip or piece of something, or the smallest possible amount of it.
example: There is not a shred of evidence to support that claim.
examplePersian: هیچ ذره‌ای از مدرکی برای پشتیبانی از آن ادعا وجود ندارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To walk on or crush something underfoot carelessly.
persianMeaning: زیر پا لگد کردن؛ بی‌رحمانه له کردن
example: Visitors trampled the grass to reach the viewpoint.
examplePersian: بازدیدکنندگان برای رسیدن به دیدگاه، چمن‌ها را لگد کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Extra material placed at the end of a book.
example: The appendix contains detailed statistical tables.
examplePersian: پیوست شامل جدول‌های آماری دقیق است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: Bustle means the busy noisy movement of a lot of people in a place.
example: There was a bustle in the market as the stallholders packed up their goods.
examplePersian: هنگام جمع کردن بارها، بازار پرهیاهو و پرسروصدا بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The climax is the most exciting or important moment in a series of events.
example: The climax of the rescue came when the last child was pulled out.
examplePersian: اوج عملیات نجات بود که آخرین کودک بیرون کشیده شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Not active at present, but able to become active later.
example: The volcano has been dormant for more than three centuries.
examplePersian: این آتشفشان بیش از سه سده در حالت سکون بوده است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To imagine a possible situation or result in advance.
example: People rarely envisage how quickly technology can change.
examplePersian: مردم به‌ندرت تصور می‌کنند فناوری چقدر سریع می‌تواند تغییر کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: An argument based on reasoning that is not valid.

englishDefinition: A flat floating thing made of logs or planks that carries people or goods.
