examplePersian: ما از بشکه‌های خالی تخته‌ای ساختیم و از رودخانه گذشتیم.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Solid material that settles and collects at the bottom of a liquid.
example: Layers of sediment at the bottom of the lake record thousands of years of climate change.
examplePersian: لایه‌های رسوب در کف دریاچه هزاران سال تغییرات آب‌وهوا را ثبت می‌کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: Understood and agreed without being said out loud.
example: There was a tacit agreement that the question would not be raised.
examplePersian: توافقی ضمنی وجود داشت که این پرسش مطرح نشود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Make a difficult situation worse.
example: Cutting the bus service only aggravated the traffic problem.
examplePersian: قطع سرویس اتوبوس تنها مشکل ترافیک را بدتر کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Buoyant means able to float easily, or cheerful and full of confidence.
example: The new product was launched on a buoyant market in which demand kept rising.
examplePersian: محصول جدید در بازاری پررونق عرضه شد که تقاضا در آن پیوسته بالا می‌رفت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A large round hollow at the top of a volcano, or a hole made by an explosion.
example: The crater of the volcano is now filled with hot mud.
examplePersian: دهانه آتشفشان اکنون پر از گل داغ است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: One of the fixed values that a country's money is divided into.
example: The two-dollar denomination is rarely used in everyday trade.
examplePersian: اسکناس دو دلاری به‌ندرت در معاملات روزمره به کار می‌رود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To avoid answering a question or doing something.
example: He evaded the question by changing the subject.
examplePersian: او با عوض کردن موضوع از پاسخ به سؤال طفره رفت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To change slightly and quickly in brightness.
example: The old lamp flickered whenever the wind rose.
examplePersian: لامپ قدیمی با هر باد سوسو می‌زد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: تسلیم شدن به؛ جا دادن به
englishDefinition: To be replaced by something else, or to stop resisting.
example: Over several decades, coal gave way to natural gas.
examplePersian: طی چند دهه، زغال‌سنگ جای خود را به گاز طبیعی داد.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Done without being planned or prepared in advance.
example: The chief executive was asked to make an impromptu statement to the press.
examplePersian: از مدیرعامل خواسته شد بیانیه‌ای ناگهانی برای مطبوعات بدهد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: بنیان نهادن؛ وضع کردن؛ تعیین کردن
englishDefinition: To establish a rule or principle.
example: The charter lays down clear limits on what companies may store.
examplePersian: این منشور حدود روشنی را برای آنچه شرکت‌ها مجاز به ذخیره‌سازی هستند تعیین می‌کند.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Very quiet and mild, and always obeying what other people want.
example: The meek young worker accepted every change without saying a word.
examplePersian: کارگر جوان و فروتن هر تغییری را بی‌آنکه سخنی بگوید پذیرفت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Appearing to be one thing, although the real situation is different.
example: The ostensible purpose of the visit was trade rather than politics.
examplePersian: هدف ظاهری این سفر تجارت بود نه سیاست.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Attractive in an old-fashioned way, like a painting.
example: The village is a picturesque fishing town in summer.
examplePersian: روستا در تابستان شهری ماهیگیری و منظره‌گرداز است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: شادی کردن و ابراز سرور از رویدادی
englishDefinition: To feel very happy about something that has happened.
example: The villagers rejoiced when the road was finally repaired.
examplePersian: مردم روستا وقتی جاده بالاخره تعمیر شد شادی کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: خراشیدن، ساییدن و کشیدن با فشار
englishDefinition: To rub a sharp or rough object against a surface so that a harsh sound is made.
example: He scraped the last of the paint from the old frame.
examplePersian: او آخرین لایه رنگ را از قاب قدیمی خراشید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Something that is small and unimportant.
example: The arguments over office space were a trifle.
examplePersian: دلخوری بر سر فضای دفتر چیز پیش‌پاافتاده‌ای بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Clap your hands to show that you like a performance.
example: The audience stood up and applauded the young conductor.
examplePersian: تماشاچیان ایستادند و برای نوازنده جوان تشویق کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Make somebody completely confused.
example: The sudden change in the rules bewildered the new staff.
examplePersian: تغییر ناگهانی قوانین کارکنان تازه‌وارد را سردرگم کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Growing by adding one thing to another, so the total keeps increasing.
example: The cumulative effect of small changes over years is enormous.
examplePersian: اثر انباشتی تغییرات کوچک در طول سال‌ها، عظیم است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A difference between two things that should be the same.
example: There is a discrepancy between the two accounts of the same night.
examplePersian: میان دو روایت از همان شب تناقضی وجود دارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: بیرون راندن از یک جا یا خودرو
englishDefinition: To force someone or something out of a place or vehicle.
example: The airline ejected several passengers who refused to leave the aircraft.
examplePersian: شرکت هواپیمایی چند مسافر را که حاضر به ترک هواپیما نبودند، بیرون کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Someone who came before and prepared the way.
example: Pioneers are the forerunners of modern astronomy.
examplePersian: پیشگامان پیش‌قدم‌های نجوم مدرن هستند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To agree with someone's opinion or decision without strong feeling.
example: Few committee members were willing to go along with the proposal uncritically.
examplePersian: اعضای کمی از کمیته حاضر نبودند بدون نقد پیشنهاد را بپذیرند.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: To encourage people to take a violent or unwise action.
example: A short video online incited hundreds of people to gather outside the ministry.
examplePersian: ویدئویی کوتاه در اینترنت صدها نفر را به گردآمدن مقابل وزارتخانه تحریک کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: شرح دادن؛ بیان کردن؛ چیدمان کردن
englishDefinition: To explain something clearly, or to arrange objects in a pattern.
example: The proposal lays out three stages of implementation over five years.
examplePersian: این پیشنهاد سه مرحلهٔ اجرا را در طول پنج سال شرح می‌دهد.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: To interfere in a private matter that is really somebody else's business.
example: He was fired for meddling in the accounts of another department.
examplePersian: او به‌دلیل دخالت در حساب‌های بخش دیگر از کار اخراج شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Required by law, by official rules or by strong custom.
example: Wearing a hard hat is obligatory on every building site.
examplePersian: پوشیدن کلاه ایمنی در همهٔ کارگاه‌های ساختمانی الزامی است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The central point on which something turns or on which it depends.
persianMeaning: محور؛ نقطهٔ چرخش و تکیه‌گاه اصلی
example: The whole argument pivots on one simple assumption.
examplePersian: کل استدلال بر یک فرض ساده استوار است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To take back something that you had lost or given away.
example: The tenant fought for years to reclaim the deposit.
examplePersian: مستاجر سال‌ها تلاش کرد تا ودیعه خود را پس بگیرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A force that makes a material change shape by pushing one layer of it past another.
example: Engineers tested the building's resistance to shear caused by strong winds.
examplePersian: مهندسان مقاومت ساختمان در برابر نیروی برشی ناشی از بادهای شدید را آزمودند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A large crowd of people gathered closely together.
example: A throng of shoppers blocked the entrance within minutes.
examplePersian: در چند دقیقه، ازدحام خریداران ورودی را بست.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Loud enough to be heard.
example: There was an audible hum from the ventilation system.
examplePersian: صدای وزوزی از سیستم تهویه به‌گوش می‌رسید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A list of books that a course or reader recommends.
example: The tutor sent us a booklist for the summer term.
examplePersian: استاد برای ترم تابستان فهرست کتاب‌ها را برای ما فرستاد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To conform means to behave according to accepted rules or expectations.
example: New uniforms make it easier for staff to conform to the dress code.
examplePersian: یونیفرم تازه پیروی از پوشش رسمی را برای کارکنان آسان‌تر می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To spread out over a wide area instead of staying in one place.
example: The smell of the paint diffused slowly through the hall.
examplePersian: بوی رنگ به‌آرامی در سالن پخش شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To involve something or make something necessary.
example: Any new plan entails a great deal of preparation.
examplePersian: هر طرح جدید مستلزم مقدار زیادی آمادگی است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To become weaker or less confident.
example: His voice faltered as he tried to answer.
examplePersian: صدایش هنگام تلاش برای پاسخ دادن لرزید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Very thin, especially because of illness.
example: Illness had left him gaunt and pale.
examplePersian: بیماری او را لاغر و رنگ‌پریده کرده بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The strong tendency to keep doing the same thing and to resist change.
example: Organisational inertia prevents many good ideas from ever being tested.
examplePersian: اینرسی سازمانی مانع از آزمودن بسیاری از ایده‌های خوب می‌شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To match the reputation or promise that something has.
example: The new stadium has not lived up to the promise of the campaign.
examplePersian: ورزشگاه جدید به وعدهٔ کمپینی که داده بود پاسخ نداد.
collocations: has lived up to its reputation
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Connected with trade and commerce, especially with buying and selling goods.
example: The port grew from a small fishing village into a busy mercantile town.
examplePersian: این بندر از روستای کوچک ماهیگیری به شهری تجاری و پررونق تبدیل شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Willing and pleasant in the way that they help other people.
persianMeaning: یاری‌گر؛ خوش‌برخورد و مایل به کمک
example: The obliging receptionist found us a taxi within minutes.
examplePersian: پذیرایشان مایل به کمک ظرف چند دقیقه برای ما تاکسی پیدا کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A liquid drink that is believed to have special healing or magical power.
example: The story describes a potion that grants invisibility.
examplePersian: داستان از معجونی سخن می‌گوید که نامرئی‌بودن می‌بخشد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: حواله، ارسال وجه به فردی در جای دیگر
englishDefinition: A sum of money that is sent to someone who lives somewhere else.
example: Migrants send a remittance home at the end of each month.
examplePersian: مهاجران در پایان هر ماه حواله‌ای به خانه می‌فرستند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To separate a person or group from others, especially on the basis of race, religion or sex.
example: The law was introduced to stop landlords segregating housing applicants by race.
examplePersian: این قانون برای جلوگیری از تفکیک متقاضیان مسکن بر اساس نژاد توسط مالکان ارائه شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A loud confused noise caused by a crowd of people.
example: A loud tumult greeted the announcement in the hall.
examplePersian: در سالن با اعلان، هیاهویی بلند برخاست.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A judgement about the quality or value of something.
example: The annual appraisal helps staff plan their next year.
examplePersian: ارزیابی سالانه به کارکنان کمک می‌کند سال بعد را برنامه‌ریزی کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A piece of furniture with shelves for books.
example: The tall bookcase takes up half the wall.
examplePersian: قفسه کتاب بلند نیمی از دیوار را اشغال می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To cherish something means to value it and protect it carefully.
example: The villagers still cherish the custom of sharing food at harvest time.
examplePersian: روستاییان هنوز رسم تقسیم غذا در فصل برداشت را گرامی می‌دارند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Belonging to or affecting one department only.
example: A departmental meeting was called to discuss the new budget.
examplePersian: برای بحث درباره بودجه جدید جلسه‌ای در سطح بخش برگزار شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Fair and equal in the way things are shared.
example: Residents demanded an equitable distribution of the new housing.
examplePersian: ساکنان توزیع منصفانه مسکن‌های جدید را مطالبه کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Very careful about small details and tidy work.
example: He is fastidious about keeping every record in order.
examplePersian: او وسواسی است و وسواس دارد که هر سابقه‌ای مرتب باشد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Too bright and colourful in a way that looks cheap.
example: The walls were painted a gaudy yellow.
examplePersian: دیوارها به رنگ زرد جیغ رنگ شده بودند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Happening immediately, with no delay at all.
example: The response was instantaneous once the button was pressed.
examplePersian: به‌محض فشردن دکمه، پاسخ بی‌درنگ بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A soldier who is paid to fight for a group rather than serving his own country.
example: The army was defeated by a small group of paid mercenaries.
examplePersian: این ارتش توسط گروه کوچکی از مزدوران پولی شکست خورد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To move repeatedly from one side, level or value to another.
persianMeaning: نوسان کردن؛ رفت‌وبرگشت بین دو حالت
example: The temperature oscillates between five and fifteen degrees.
examplePersian: دما میان پنج تا پانزده درجه نوسان می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Dealing with a situation in a practical way rather than by theory.
persianMeaning: عمل‌گرا؛ مبتنی بر واقع‌بینی و نتیجه
example: They took a pragmatic approach and repaired the roof first.
examplePersian: آنها رویکردی عمل‌گرا در پیش گرفتند و نخست بام را تعمیر کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

persianMeaning: مجموعه توانایی‌ها، آثار و منابع در دسترس یک هنرمند یا گروه
englishDefinition: The whole range of skills, works or resources that a person or group can draw on.
example: The course develops the full repertoire of skills a first manager needs.
examplePersian: این دوره مجموعه توانایی‌هایی را پرورش می‌دهد که نخستین مدیر به آن نیاز دارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Divided into distinct sections or separate pieces that can be arranged in different ways.
example: A sectional sofa is more practical than a traditional sofa in a small flat.
examplePersian: مبل راحتی ریزی در آپارتمان کوچک کاربردی‌تر از مبل‌های سنتی است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To make a metal surface dull or discoloured, especially through oxidation.
persianMeaning: زنگ زدن؛ کدر و لک‌دار کردن سطح فلز
example: Moisture in the air can tarnish the shine on silver cutlery.
examplePersian: رطوبت هوا می‌تواند جلای قاشق و چنگال نقره‌ای را کدر کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: An animal that lives in water and on land, such as a frog.
example: Frogs are amphibians that begin life in water.
examplePersian: قورباغه‌ها دوزیستانی هستند که زندگی‌شان را در آب آغاز می‌کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The state of having no hair on the head.
example: His baldness became more noticeable as he grew older.
examplePersian: کچلی او با افزایش سن بیشتر به چشم می‌آمد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To contemplate something means to think about it deeply before deciding.
example: The council is contemplating closing the smaller village schools.
examplePersian: شورا در حال سبک‌سنجی بستن مدارس کوچک روستا است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The feeling you have when something happens that you find worrying or alarming.
example: To our dismay, the second experiment gave the opposite result.
examplePersian: برخلاف انتظار ما، آزمایش دوم نتیجه‌ای معکوس داد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To use your power or influence to make something happen.
example: Teachers rarely exert pressure on students to cheat.
examplePersian: معلمان به‌ندرت بر دانشجویان فشار می‌آورند که تقلب کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Full of something harmful or difficult.
example: The journey was fraught with difficulties from the start.
examplePersian: سفر از همان آغاز آکنده از دشواری بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: In a bright and cheerful way.
example: The children sang gaily at the village festival.
examplePersian: کودکان در جشنواره روستا شادمانه می‌خواندند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Very bad at doing something, because of poor skill or poor judgement.
example: The design was rejected as wholly inept by the technical review panel.
examplePersian: این طرح به‌دلیل ناکارآمدی کامل از سوی کمیته فنی رد شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A long speech by one person, in which nobody else answers or speaks.
example: The first half of the play is a long monologue by the main character.
examplePersian: نیمهٔ نخست نمایش تک‌گویی طولانی از شخصیت اصلی است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Used to give the reason for something.
example: Flights were cancelled on account of the storm.
examplePersian: پروازها به دلیل توفان لغو شد.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: The state of being unable to move or act, or of stopping completely.
persianMeaning: فلج؛ ناتوانی کامل از حرکت یا عمل
example: A power cut caused hours of paralysis in the capital.
examplePersian: قطعی برق ساعت‌ها فلج‌شدگی در پایتخت ایجاد کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: چرخیدن به دور یک محور یا مرکز
englishDefinition: To turn around a central point, or to move in a circle.
example: The Earth revolves around the Sun once in a year.
examplePersian: زمین یک بار در سال به دور خورشید می‌چرخد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To make somebody become ill, especially suddenly and seriously.
example: Chemicals from the factory sickened several families nearby.
examplePersian: مواد شیمیایی کارخانه چند خانواده‌ی همسایه را بیمار کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A slight amount of a colour or feeling added to something.
persianMeaning: رنگ یا حس اندکی از چیزی
example: There was a faint tinge of sarcasm in his reply.
examplePersian: در پاسخ او ته‌رنگی از طعنه وجود داشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Something you do or give to make up for a wrong.
example: He made full amends to the workers he had dismissed.
examplePersian: او بابت کارگرانی که اخراج کرده بود کامل دلجویی کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Exchange goods without using money.
example: In the old market, farmers bartered grain for salt.
examplePersian: در بازار قدیم، کشاورزان غلات را با نمک مبادله می‌کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A large military unit made up of several divisions and its own support staff.
example: The corps was stationed on the northern border for six months.
examplePersian: این یگان به مدت شش ماه در مرز شمالی مستقر بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To purify a liquid by heating it so that it evaporates and then condenses again.
example: Distil the seawater twice to get drinking-quality water.
examplePersian: آب دریا را دو بار تقطیر کنید تا آب آشامیدنی به دست آید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To a very great degree.
example: The problem is exceedingly difficult to solve.
examplePersian: این مشکل به‌شدت دشوار برای حل شدن است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Careful with money and resources.
example: A frugal household wastes neither food nor electricity.
examplePersian: خانواری کم‌مصرف نه غذا و نه برق را هدر نمی‌دهد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To pass on knowledge, information or a quality to somebody.
example: Old builders imparted their skills to apprentices over long winters.
examplePersian: سازندگان قدیمی در زمستان‌های طولانی مهارت‌های خود را به شاگردان منتقل می‌کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The scientific study of very small living things, such as bacteria and viruses.
example: She specialised in microbiology and now studies harmful bacteria in food.
examplePersian: او در میکروبیولوژی تخصص گرفت و اکنون باکتری‌های مضر در غذا را مطالعه می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Used to state what must happen for something to be allowed.
example: The subsidy is granted on condition that the land stays in farming use.
examplePersian: این یارانه به شرط آنکه زمین در کاربری کشاورزی بماند اعطا می‌شود.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: An extremely strong and unreasonable fear of something.
example: She has a phobia about insects that stops her walking outside.
examplePersian: او نسبت به حشرات ترسی بیمارگونه دارد که بیرون رفتن را برایش دشوار می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: موج کوچک و لرزش روی سطح آب
englishDefinition: A small wave that moves across the surface of water.
example: A stone thrown into the pond made ripples across the water.
examplePersian: سنگی که در برکه انداخته شد موج‌های کوچکی روی آب ایجاد کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: بهداشتی، پاک و عاری از آلودگی
englishDefinition: Clean and healthy, especially with regard to water, food and waste.
example: The report criticised the poor sanitary conditions in the block.
examplePersian: گزارش شرایط بهداشتی نامناسب آن محله را نقد کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The act of entering land or a building without permission.
persianMeaning: تجاوز؛ ورود بدون اجازه به زمین یا ساختمان
example: Trespass on this land is punishable by a fine.
examplePersian: تجاوز به این زمین جریمه‌ای را در پی دارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The act of going up, or a path that goes up.
example: The ascent from the village took three hours.
examplePersian: صعود از روستا سه ساعت طول کشید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To burgeon means to grow quickly and strongly, especially in number.
example: Interest in renewable energy has burgeoned over the past decade.
examplePersian: علاقه به انرژی‌های تجدیدپذیر در دهه گذشته به‌سرعت گسترش یافته است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To have a close connection with something, so that one changes with the other.
example: Income and life expectancy correlate closely in rich countries.
examplePersian: درآمد و امید به زندگی در کشورهای ثروتمند همبستگی نزدیکی دارند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: To notice or understand something that is not obvious.
example: It is hard to discern any pattern in the second half of the data.
examplePersian: تشخیص الگویی در نیمه دوم داده‌ها دشوار است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: مظهر بودن و نمود بارز بودن
englishDefinition: To be the perfect example of a quality or an idea.
example: Her career embodies the idea that hard work leads to success.
examplePersian: مسیر شغلی او نمونه بارز این باور است که تلاش سخت به موفقیت می‌انجامد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Lasting for a very short time only.
example: He caught a fleeting glimpse of the bird before it flew away.
examplePersian: او پیش از پرواز پرنده لحظه‌ای آن را دید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Not moving, not working, or having no effect.
example: Tin cans do not decompose and remain largely inert in landfill sites.
examplePersian: قوطی‌های قلعی تجزیه نمی‌شوند و در زباله‌دان‌ها تا حد زیادی خنثی می‌مانند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To think about something carefully for a long time, or to sit quietly and calmly.
example: He sat quietly to meditate before making the final decision.
examplePersian: او پیش از گرفتن تصمیم نهایی، آرام نشست و تأمل کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Used to give the reason, especially a formal or legal one.
example: The appeal was rejected on grounds of insufficient evidence.
examplePersian: درخواست تجدیدنظر به دلیل فقدان شواهد کافی رد شد.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: A person who travels a long way to visit a holy place.
persianMeaning: زائر؛ کسی که برای زیارت مکان مقدس سفر می‌کند
example: Thousands of pilgrims walked to the shrine before dawn.
examplePersian: هزاران زائر پیش از سپیده‌دم به زیارتگاه رفتند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: آرام کردن، اطمینان دادن و ترس را کاستن
englishDefinition: To say or do something that makes a worried person feel calmer.
example: The nurse reassured the patient that the pain would soon pass.
examplePersian: پرستار به بیمار اطمینان داد که درد به‌زودی برطرف می‌شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To bring something under control by using force or calm persuasion.
example: Firefighters spent hours trying to subdue the blaze in the warehouse.
examplePersian: آتش‌نشان‌ها ساعت‌ها تلاش کردند آتش انبار را مهار کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To consider something before making a decision.
example: The model takes account of seasonal variation rather than assuming a constant rate.
examplePersian: این مدل تغییرات فصلی را در نظر می‌گیرد تا اینکه نرخ ثابتی فرض کند.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Coming from an official or well-respected source.
example: We need an authoritative source before we publish this figure.
examplePersian: پیش از انتشار این رقم به یک منبع معتبر نیاز داریم.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Having a particular natural tendency or inclination.
example: She is bent on finishing the report by Friday.
examplePersian: او عزم دارد گزارش را تا جمعه تمام کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To coincide means to happen at the same time, or to match exactly.
example: The exhibition coincides with the school holidays, so bookings are heavy.
examplePersian: نمایشگاه با تعطیلات مدارس هم‌زمان است، بنابراین رزروها زیاد است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: So completely empty that nothing lives there, or it is bleak and sad.
example: The war left the farming villages desolate for years afterwards.
examplePersian: جنگ روستاهای کشاورزی را سال‌ها ویران باقی گذاشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Changing suddenly and unpredictably.
example: The weather here is notoriously erratic in autumn.
examplePersian: هوا در اینجا در پاییز به‌طرز معروفی نوسانی و غیرقابل پیش‌بینی است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To change repeatedly between levels.
example: Shop prices fluctuated wildly during the year.
examplePersian: قیمت‌ها در طول سال به‌شدت نوسان کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Too many to be counted.
example: The paper has been cited in innumerable studies since it appeared.
examplePersian: این مقاله از زمان انتشار در بی‌شمار پژوهش‌ها ارجاع داده شده است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Showing a strong interest in death, disease, or unpleasant subjects, in an unhealthy way.
example: The article has a morbid fascination with accidents and disaster.
examplePersian: این مقاله شیفتگی بیمارانه‌ای به حوادث و فاجعه دارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Used when something is accepted as true in order to continue.
example: The forecast rests on the assumption that prices remain stable.
examplePersian: این پیش‌بینی بر پایهٔ این فرض استوار است که قیمت‌ها ثابت بمانند.
collocations: on the assumption that demand holds
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

persianMeaning: با نیروی زیاد به جلو راندن
englishDefinition: To push or drive something forward with great force.
example: Small improvements propelled the company to the top of the market.
examplePersian: بهبودهای کوچک شرکت را به صدر بازار رساند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: کینه ورزیدن و دلخوری از بی‌انصافی
englishDefinition: To feel bitter or angry about something that you think is unfair.
example: Staff resented having their hours cut at short notice.
examplePersian: کارکنان از کوتاه شدن ساعت کاری با اطلاع کوتاه مدت ناراحت بودند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Small in number and thinly spread out, with large gaps between things.
example: Vegetation in the region is sparse because rainfall is very low.
examplePersian: پوشش گیاهی منطقه به‌دلیل بارش بسیار کم، تنگ و پراکنده است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To consider something when making a judgement or calculation.
example: The policy failed to take into account how quickly habits actually change.
examplePersian: این سیاست لحاظ نکرد که عادت‌ها واقعاً با چه سرعتی تغییر می‌کنند.
commonMistakes: Do not write 'take in account'; the idiom always includes 'into'.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Be next to or joined to something.
example: The two cottages adjoin a narrow strip of woodland.
examplePersian: دو کلبه به نوار باریکی از جنگل مجاورند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To browse means to look at or search through something without a clear plan.
example: Job seekers often browse the internet for hours without applying for anything.
examplePersian: جویندگان کار اغلب ساعت‌ها اینترنت را می‌گردند بدون آنکه برای چیزی درخواست بدهند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To commemorate something means to mark an important past event with a ceremony.
example: A ceremony was held to commemorate the fiftieth anniversary of the peace.
examplePersian: مراسمی برای بزرگداشت پنجاهمین سالگرد صلح برگزار شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To eat something very quickly, or to destroy something completely.
example: Fire devoured the wooden building within the hour.
examplePersian: آتش در کمتر از یک ساعت ساختمان چوبی را بلعید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To send out light, gas, sound or radiation.
example: The new factory must not emit noise before ten at night.
examplePersian: کارخانه جدید نباید پیش از ساعت ده شب صدا منتشر کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

persianMeaning: پناه بردن به؛ ناچار شدن به استفاده از
englishDefinition: To use something or someone when there is no other choice.
example: When funding was cut, the laboratory fell back on equipment donations.
examplePersian: هنگام کاهش بودجه، آزمایشگاه ناچار به استفاده از کمک‌های تجهیزاتی شد.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: An expression whose meaning is very different from its individual words.
example: Try to avoid slang idioms in a formal academic essay.
examplePersian: در مقالهٔ دانشگاهی رسمی از اصطلاحات عامیانه پرهیز کنید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Extremely careful about small details, so that nothing is done wrongly or missed.
example: The building was restored over eight years with meticulous attention to detail.
examplePersian: بنایشان طی هشت سال با دقتی وسواسی نسبت به جزئیات بازسازی شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Used to state the opposite of what was just said.
example: The drug did not reduce symptoms; on the contrary, it increased them.
examplePersian: این دارو علائم را کاهش نداد؛ برعکس، آن‌ها را افزایش داد.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: A flat metal disc that moves up and down inside a cylinder.
persianMeaning: پیستون؛ قطعهٔ آهنی رانده در سیلندر
example: A worn piston caused the engine to lose power.
examplePersian: پیستون فرسوده باعث افت توان موتور شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The person or office whose job is to keep official records and enrolments.
example: The university registrar confirmed her place on the course in writing.
examplePersian: اداره ثبت دانشگاه جای او در دوره را کتبی تأیید کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Added to something else in order to make it complete or more useful.
example: Supplementary funding allowed the team to test a larger sample.
examplePersian: بودجه‌ی تکمیلی به تیم اجازه داد نمونه‌ی بزرگ‌تری را آزمایش کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To accept advice or an idea and act on it.
example: The committee did not take on board the objections raised by residents.
examplePersian: کمیته اعتراضات ساکنان را جدی نگرفت.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Uncertainty because something can be understood in more than one way.
example: The ambiguity of the rules caused arguments between teams.
examplePersian: ابهام قوانین باعث اختلاف میان تیم‌ها شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: نسبت داده شدن به؛ منتسب بودن به
englishDefinition: To be explained as the result of a particular cause.
example: The decline has been attributed to a single failed harvest.
examplePersian: این کاهش به یک محصول ناموفق نسبت داده شده است.
antonyms: be caused by no known factor
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Concise means short and clear, using as few words as possible.
example: The report is concise, yet it covers every point of the debate.
examplePersian: این گزارش موجز است اما همه نکات بحث را پوشش می‌دهد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: خرام کردن با توهم، فریب دادن
englishDefinition: To make someone believe something false, especially something hopeful.
example: Do not delude yourself that a short course gives a qualification.
examplePersian: خود را گول نزنید که دوره کوتاه مدرکی به شما می‌دهد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A legal order that stops trade with a country.
example: The government imposed an arms embargo on two countries last year.
examplePersian: دولت سال گذشته تحریم تسلیحاتی بر دو کشور اعمال کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: اول از همه؛ در وهلهٔ نخست
englishDefinition: Used to say what is the most important consideration.
example: First and foremost, the scheme must protect the poorest households.
examplePersian: اول از همه، طرح باید خانوارهای فقیرتر را محافظت کند.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: An amount of money paid to somebody to make sure they lose nothing.
example: The policy pays a small indemnity to anyone whose car is stolen.
examplePersian: این بیمه‌نامه به هر کسی که خودرویش سرقت شود غرامت اندکی می‌پردازد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A person whose behaviour is extremely wild and violent, especially during a period of mental illness.
example: A maniac with a knife frightened everyone in the shopping centre.
examplePersian: مردی دیوانه با چاقو همه را در مرکز خرید ترساند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Used to introduce the reason given for a decision.
example: The council refused planning permission on the grounds that the site was too small.
examplePersian: شورا با این استدلال که محل بیش از حد کوچک است اجازهٔ ساخت نداد.
collocations: on the grounds that it is
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: A difficult and sad situation that someone is in.
example: The film describes the plight of migrant workers abroad.
examplePersian: این فیلم وضعیت دشوار کارگران مهاجر در خارج را توصیف می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: توبه کردن و پشیمانی از کردن
englishDefinition: To feel sorry for something bad you have done and change your behaviour because of it.
example: He repented too late to repair the damage to his family.
examplePersian: او خیلی دیر توبه کرد تا آسیبی که به خانواده‌اش زده بود جبران کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Containing salt, or consisting of salt water.
example: Crops grown on saline soil need far more water.
examplePersian: محصولاتی که در خاک شور کاشته می‌شوند به آب بسیار بیشتری نیاز دارند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Used to introduce how far something is true.
example: The extent to which the drug helps depends on the dose.
examplePersian: میزان اثربخشی دارو به دوز آن بستگی دارد.
collocations: to the extent to which X
the extent to which this is true
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: The period of life between childhood and adulthood.
example: During adolescence, most people experience rapid emotional change.
examplePersian: در دوران نوجوانی بیشتر افراد تغییرات هیجانی سریعی را تجربه می‌کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: متعهد بودن به؛ پایبند بودن به
englishDefinition: To be strongly dedicated to a course of action.
example: The agency is committed to reducing waiting times by a fifth.
examplePersian: این نهاد متعهد است زمان انتظار را به میزان یک‌پنجم کاهش دهد.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: To constrict something means to make it narrower, or to limit it.
example: Cold air constricts the blood vessels in the hands.
examplePersian: هوای سرد رگ‌های خونی دست‌ها را تنگ می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The reduction of a supply of something until it is nearly or completely gone.
example: Overfishing has caused the depletion of fish stocks in the Atlantic.
examplePersian: صید بیش از اندازه ذخایر ماهی در اقیانوس اطلس را تخلیه کرده است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To remove something completely so that it never returns.
example: The campaign aims to eradicate the disease in ten years.
examplePersian: این کارزار هدفش ریشه‌کن کردن بیماری در ده سال است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To worry about something small.
example: Do not fret about the small details.
examplePersian: نگران جزئیات کوچک نباش.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Very angry because something is unfair or wrong.
example: Residents were indignant that the park was closed without notice.
examplePersian: ساکنان از اینکه پارک بدون اطلاع بسته شده بود خشمگین بودند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Moving from one place to another each year, as birds and many fish do.
example: Migratory birds arrive at the wetland every spring to lay their eggs.
examplePersian: پرندگان مهاجر هر بهار برای تخم‌گذاری به تالاب می‌رسند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Used to say what an event was connected with.
example: The ceremony took place on the occasion of the museum's centenary.
examplePersian: مراسم به مناسبت صدمین سالگرد تأسیس موزه برگزار شد.
collocations: on the occasion of the wedding
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: The force or system that pushes something such as a vehicle forward.
example: The aircraft relies on jet propulsion to reach cruising altitude.
examplePersian: این هواپیما برای رسیدن به ارتفاع پرواز به نیروی محرکه جت متکی است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: هیاهو و سر و صدای بلند و آزاردهنده
englishDefinition: A very loud unpleasant noise, especially one that lasts for a while.
example: The drill next door made a terrible racket all afternoon.
examplePersian: مته همسایه تمام عصر سر و صدای وحشتناکی راه انداخت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: به‌سختی، تقریباً نه و تنها در آستانه وقوع
englishDefinition: Used to say that something is only just true or only just happened.
example: There was scarcely any shade anywhere in the dry valley.
examplePersian: در دره خشک، تقریباً هیچ سایه‌ای نبود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The moment when something such as a condition begins.
example: The onset of the illness was sudden in most cases.
examplePersian: آغاز بیماری در بیشتر موارد ناگهانی بود.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: State something firmly, especially as a fact.
example: The report affirms that the danger to workers is real.
examplePersian: گزارش تأیید می‌کند که خطر برای کارگران واقعی است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

persianMeaning: مشغول بودن به؛ درگیر بودن در
englishDefinition: To be involved in an activity or process.
example: Most adults are engaged in some form of paid work.
examplePersian: بیشتر بزرگسالان به نوعی کار با مزد مشغول هستند.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: A contradiction is a statement that clashes with another statement, making both doubtful.
example: The report contains a contradiction that no editor noticed.
examplePersian: گزارش تناقضی دارد که هیچ ویراستاری متوجهش نشد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The state of feeling so tired that you can hardly keep your eyes open.
example: Long meetings at work are a common cause of drowsiness at the wheel.
examplePersian: جلسه‌های طولانی کار یکی از دلایل رایج خواب‌آلودگی پشت فرمان است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To bring a strong feeling or memory into the mind.
example: The old photographs evoked happy childhood memories.
examplePersian: عکس‌های قدیمی خاطرات شاد دوران کودکی را تداعی کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A thing that a person is especially good at.
example: Careful planning is her forte in this industry.
examplePersian: برنامه‌ریزی دقیق نقطه قوت او در این صنعت است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Impossible to remove or wash off.
example: The museum used a marker with indelible ink to number the oldest stones.
examplePersian: موزه از خودکاری با جوهر پاک‌نشدنی برای شماره‌گذاری قدیمی‌ترین سنگ‌ها استفاده کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To move among people in a relaxed way, talking to different people.
example: Guests were invited to mingle and talk about the exhibition.
examplePersian: مهمانان دعوت شدند در جمع بگردند و دربارهٔ نمایشگاه گفت‌وگو کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To make a new possibility available.
example: Cheap credit opened the door to home ownership for many families.
examplePersian: وام ارزان راه خانه‌دار شدن را برای بسیاری از خانواده‌ها گشود.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: The highest point of a success, career or mountain.
example: The film marked the pinnacle of her career as a director.
examplePersian: این فیلم اوج کارنامهٔ او به‌عنوان کارگردان بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: ملاقات تعیین‌شده در زمان و مکان معین
englishDefinition: A meeting that has been arranged for a particular time and place.
example: The two officers used an abandoned barn as a rendezvous.
examplePersian: دو افسر از یک انبار متروکه به‌عنوان محل ملاقات استفاده کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Not growing, developing or changing at all over a long period of time.
example: Real wages remained stagnant even as living costs rose sharply.
examplePersian: دستمزد واقعی با وجود افزایش شدید هزینه‌های زندگی راکد ماند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The underlying reason a problem exists.
example: Investigators are looking for the root cause of the contamination.
examplePersian: محققان در جست‌وجوی علت ریشه‌ای آلودگی هستند.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: A short personal story about something that actually happened.
example: The speaker opened with an anecdote about his childhood village.
examplePersian: سخنران با حکایتی از روستای دوران کودکی‌اش شروع کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To have a legal or moral right to something.
example: Every resident is entitled to free emergency care.
examplePersian: هر ساکن حق دریافت خدمات اورژانسی رایگان را دارد.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: A cafeteria is a place, often in a school or workplace, where people buy cheap meals.
example: The pupils eat in the cafeteria every afternoon after their lessons.
examplePersian: دانش‌آموزان هر بعدازهار پس از کلاس‌ها در سفره‌خانه غذا می‌خورند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To make a worry, doubt or unpleasant feeling go away.
example: The new figures helped dispel doubts about the programme's success.
examplePersian: آمار جدید به رفع تردیدها درباره موفقیت برنامه کمک کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Wrong, especially because of a mistake.
example: The report contained several erroneous figures about population growth.
examplePersian: گزارش چند عدد نادرست درباره رشد جمعیت داشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The point at which a plan or idea produces real results.
example: After years of debate the plan finally came to fruition.
examplePersian: پس از سال‌ها بحث، طرح سرانجام به ثمره رسید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Easy to understand, despite being complicated or spoken with an accent.
example: The report is full of figures that are hardly intelligible to a lay reader.
examplePersian: این گزارش پر از عددهایی است که برای خوانندهٔ غیرمتخصص به‌سختی قابل فهم است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Waste from animals that is spread on fields in order to make the soil richer.
example: Farmers spread manure on their fields before every new planting.
examplePersian: کشاورزان پیش از هر کاشت تازه، کود دامی روی زمین‌هایشان می‌پاشند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Used to give a reason, especially for something negative.
example: Owing to the delay, the ceremony was moved to the following spring.
examplePersian: به دلیل تأخیر، مراسم به بهار بعد منتقل شد.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Calm confidence combined with a controlled balance of the body.
persianMeaning: آرامش مطمئن؛ تسلط همراه با متانت
example: She accepted the criticism with remarkable poise.
examplePersian: او نقد را با آرامشی چشمگیر پذیرفت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: نگاه به گذشته و بازنگری در رویدادها
englishDefinition: A thinking back about the past in order to judge what happened.
example: In retrospect the decision to close the line was clearly wrong.
examplePersian: در بازگشت به گذشته، تصمیم به بستن خط به‌روشنی اشتباه بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A white carbohydrate stored in seeds, roots and tubers that the body turns into energy.
example: Potatoes and white rice are both rich in starch, so they release energy slowly.
examplePersian: سیب‌زمینی و برنج سفید هر دو نشاسته‌ی فراوان دارند، بنابراین انرژی را آهسته آزاد می‌کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: نوک کوه یخ؛ بخش کوچکی از یک مشکل بزرگ
englishDefinition: The small part of a difficulty that is visible.
example: The reported cases are only the tip of the iceberg.
examplePersian: موارد گزارش‌شده تنها نوک کوه یخ است.
synonyms: the visible part of a larger problem
collocations: is only the tip of the iceberg
just the tip of the iceberg
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Very old, and belonging to an earlier period.
example: The phrase sounds archaic to modern speakers.
examplePersian: این عبارت برای گویشوران امروزی کهنه به گوش می‌رسد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To be likely to do something or to hold a view.
example: Few reviewers are inclined to trust self-reported data.
examplePersian: تعداد اندکی از داوران مایل‌اند به داده‌های خوداظهاری اعتماد کنند.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: A contingency is something that might happen and that you must plan for.
example: The plan includes money for every major contingency.
examplePersian: این طرح برای هر احتمال مهمی پول در نظر گرفته است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Almost certainly, with no doubt at all.
example: Doubtless the letter reached her before we sent a reply.
examplePersian: بی‌تردید نامه پیش از پاسخ ما به او رسیده است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To put out a fire or to stop something burning.
example: Firefighters took an hour to extinguish the blaze.
examplePersian: آتش‌نشانان یک ساعت طول کشید تا آتش را خاموش کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The soft loose threads that cover a young bird.
example: The chicks are covered in soft warm fluff.
examplePersian: جوجه‌ها با کرک نرم و گرم پوشیده شده‌اند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Rude and disrespectful towards somebody in a way that shows no respect.
example: The singer apologised for his insolent remarks to the organiser.
examplePersian: خواننده بابت گفته‌های گستاخانه‌اش نسبت به برگزارکننده عذر خواست.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To bring people together so that they work together on a job, task, or cause.
example: The charity mobilized thousands of volunteers after the floods began.
examplePersian: خیریه پس از آغاز سیل هزاران داوطلب را بسیج کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The showing off of wealth or power in an obvious and excessive way.
example: The wealth was displayed with taste rather than ostentation.
examplePersian: این ثروت با ذوق نمایش داده شد نه با فخرفروشی.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A high level of skill and accuracy in doing something.
example: Her proficiency in three languages made her an invaluable translator.
examplePersian: تسلط او به سه زبان او را به مترجمی بی‌بدلیل ارزشمند تبدیل کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: از حفظ و با صدای بلند خواندن
englishDefinition: To say something aloud from memory, especially a poem or a list.
example: The pupils recited a short poem together at the ceremony.
examplePersian: دانش‌آموزان در مراسم با هم شعری کوتاه را از حفظ خواندند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To be a sign that something means something or causes a particular result.
example: Rising sea levels signify a serious threat to coastal cities.
examplePersian: بالا رفتن سطح دریاها تهدیدی جدی برای شهرهای ساحلی را نشان می‌دهد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The fundamental reason behind an observed effect.
example: Researchers were asked to identify the underlying cause of the failure.
examplePersian: از پژوهشگران خواسته شد علت زیربنایی شکست را شناسایی کنند.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Bring out a strong feeling or reaction in someone.
example: The documentary aroused great interest in marine biology.
examplePersian: این مستند علاقه زیادی به زیست‌شناسی دریایی برانگیخت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To be under the authority or influence of something.
example: All new buildings are now subject to energy standards.
examplePersian: همهٔ ساختمان‌های جدید اکنون تابع استانداردهای انرژی هستند.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Coarse means rough in texture, or rough and impolite in manner.
example: The cheapest flour has a coarse texture and a bitter taste.
examplePersian: ارزان‌ترین آرد بافتی درشت و طعمی تلخ دارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: کم و کم شدن، تحلیل رفتن
englishDefinition: To become steadily smaller in size or amount until very little is left.
example: Supplies dwindled until the clinic ran out of basic medicine.
examplePersian: اقلام کم شد تا اینکه درمانگاه از داروهای پایه تهی شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: با زحمت زیاد چیزی به دست آوردن
englishDefinition: To manage to get a small amount of something with a lot of effort.
example: Many students eke out a living by working in restaurants during term time.
examplePersian: بسیاری از دانشجویان با کار کردن در رستوران‌ها در طول ترم هزینه زندگی خود را تأمین می‌کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The entrance hall of a hotel, theatre or large house.
example: We waited for her in the hotel foyer.
examplePersian: ما در لابی هتل منتظرش بودیم.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Strange and out of place, so that it does not fit with the surroundings.
example: A bright yellow phone box looked incongruous in that grey village.
examplePersian: یک تلفن‌خانهٔ زرد روشن در آن روستای خاکستری بی‌تناسب به نظر می‌رسید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The scientific study of the weather, and of the conditions that produce it.
example: Meteorology departments use radar and satellites to predict violent storms.
examplePersian: اداره‌های هواشناسی با رادار و ماهواره طوفان‌های شدید را پیش‌بینی می‌کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: So emotionally tired and tense that you cannot relax.
example: The nurse looked overwrought after a night shift.
examplePersian: پرستار پس از شیفت شب بیش از حد خسته به نظر می‌رسید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Serious and immediate danger that threatens someone.
persianMeaning: خطر بزرگ؛ تهدید جدی و فوری
example: The warning describes the peril of walking alone at night.
examplePersian: این هشدار خطر تنها راه رفتن در شب را توصیف می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The sudden bursting or tearing of something, especially a pipe or a relationship.
example: A rupture in the main pipe flooded three streets.
examplePersian: پارگی لوله اصلی سه خیابان را آبگرفت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Occurring occasionally and at irregular intervals rather than continuously.
example: Sporadic rainfall in the region makes grape harvests unpredictable.
examplePersian: بارش‌های پراکنده در منطقه، زمان برداشت انگور را غیرقابل پیش‌بینی می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Used to introduce a claim that research increasingly supports.
example: There is growing evidence that flexible hours raise productivity.
examplePersian: شواهد روزافزونی وجود دارد که ساعت کاری انعطاف‌پذیر بهره‌وری را افزایش می‌دهد.
collocations: there is growing evidence that X
there is growing evidence to suggest that
commonMistakes: Follow it with a full clause, not a noun phrase: not 'there is growing evidence that the effects'.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: A place where the skin is scraped or rubbed off.
example: She got a small abrasion on her knee after falling off her bike.
examplePersian: او پس از زمین خوردن از دوچرخه، سایش کوچکی روی زانویش پیدا کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: آسیب‌پذیر در برابرِ؛ در معرض خطرِ
englishDefinition: To be easily harmed or attacked.
example: Low-lying districts are especially vulnerable to flooding.
examplePersian: مناطق پستی به‌ویژه در معرض سیل آسیب‌پذیرند.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: A commonplace is something that happens so often that nobody notices it now.
example: Handwashing before meals is commonplace in most kitchens.
examplePersian: شستن دست پیش از غذا در بیشتر آشپزخانه‌ها امری رایج است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Boring and without interest, and often also dark or dull in colour.
example: The long grey afternoons in winter are dreary.
examplePersian: بعدازظهرهای بلند و خاکستری زمستان دل‌گیر هستند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To be a clear example that shows how something works.
example: Her career exemplifies the value of lifelong learning.
examplePersian: مسیر شغلی او ارزش یادگیری مادام‌العمر را نشان می‌دهد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To move lightly and quickly up and down.
example: Flags fluttered in the strong wind.
examplePersian: پرچم‌ها در باد تند تکان می‌خوردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Having no taste, and so boring that it gives no pleasure.
example: The film was insipid, with no memorable characters at all.
examplePersian: فیلم بی‌روح بود و هیچ شخصیت به‌یادماندنی نداشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Generous and forgiving towards somebody, even towards somebody who has harmed you.
example: The winner was magnanimous in victory and praised her opponent's effort.
examplePersian: برنده در پیروزی بزرگوار بود و تلاش حریفش را ستود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: One of the extremely small holes in the surface of skin or soil.

englishDefinition: To move back or to become less strong, visible or important.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A yellow chemical element that smells strong when it is burned.

examplePersian: سنگ‌های آتشفشانی منطقه حاوی رسوبات گوگرد هستند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: One of two lines of latitude about 23 degrees north or south.
persianMeaning: استوا؛ خط عرضی حدود ۲۳ درجه شمال یا جنوب
example: The plant grows well on both sides of the tropic.
examplePersian: این گیاه در دو سوی استوا به خوبی رشد می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A natural ability to do something well.
