examplePersian: او در مدرسه استعداد واقعی برای زبان نشان داد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Because of a particular quality or feature that something has.
example: The material conducts heat well by virtue of its layered structure.
examplePersian: این ماده به واسطهٔ ساختار لایه‌ای خود گرما را به خوبی هدایت می‌کند.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Open to the ideas and customs of many different countries.
example: The city has become more cosmopolitan as students and workers arrive from abroad.
examplePersian: این شهر با ورود دانشجویان و کارگران از خارج، جهان‌دیده‌تر شده است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To be almost asleep, with your eyes partly closed.
example: She drowsed in the warm chair and missed the whole speech.
examplePersian: او در صندلی گرم نیمه‌خواب شد و کل سخنرانی را از دست داد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To twist together so that they cannot be separated.
example: Several fishing boats became entangled in the thick fog.
examplePersian: چند قایق ماهیگیری در مه غلیظ گرفتار شدند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Soft and loose in a way that looks unattractive.
example: Several flabby fish were sold as fresh catches.
examplePersian: چند ماهی شل و بی‌رمق به‌عنوان صید تازه فروخته شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Used to introduce a very short summary.
example: In a nutshell, the policy rewards speed at the cost of safety.
examplePersian: به‌طور خلاصه، این سیاست سرعت را به بهای ایمنی پاداش می‌دهد.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: To speak in a low voice that is not clear, usually because you are angry or unhappy.
example: He muttered something about the delay and walked out of the room.
examplePersian: او دربارهٔ تأخیر چیزی غریبند زد و از اتاق بیرون رفت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To find the exact cause, time or place of something.
persianMeaning: دقیقاً تعیین کردن؛ نشانی گرفتن از
example: Engineers pinpointed the fault within an hour.
examplePersian: مهندسان ظرف یک ساعت ایراد را دقیقاً تعیین کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: سرزنش ملایم، انتقاد خفیف و نکوهش
englishDefinition: A word of mild criticism or blame that someone expresses about a fault.
example: He looked at me with reproach for forgetting the appointment.
examplePersian: او با نگاهی سرزنش‌آمیز نگاهم کرد چون قرار را فراموش کرده بودم.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To move in a fast circular motion, or to turn something round and round.
example: The dust swirled around the headlights of the car.
examplePersian: گرد و غبار دور چراغ‌های جلوی خودرو چرخید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Good enough to be accepted, although not pleasant.
persianMeaning: قابل تحمل؛ به‌اندازه کافی برای پذیرش
example: After the third week the temperature became barely tolerable.
examplePersian: پس از هفته سوم دما به‌زحمت قابل تحمل شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Needing a great deal of effort.
example: The climb to the summit was slow and arduous.
examplePersian: صعود به قله کند و فرسایشی بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: از طریقِ؛ به وسیلهٔ؛ به عنوانِ
englishDefinition: Using something as a method or as a name.
example: The two sides spoke by way of intermediaries rather than directly.
examplePersian: دو طرف از طریق میانجیان و نه به‌طور مستقیم صحبت کردند.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Conspicuous means so noticeable that it draws attention to itself.
example: His absence from the meeting was conspicuous.
examplePersian: غیبت او از جلسه کاملاً به چشم آمد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Neat and skilful in movement, especially with your hands.
example: With a deft touch she finished the painting before the guests arrived.
examplePersian: او با ضربه‌ای چابک پیش از آمدن مهمانان نقاشی را تمام کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To become rapidly worse or more intense.
example: The dispute escalated after both sides made public statements.
examplePersian: اختلاف پس از بیانیه‌های عمومی هر دو طرف به‌سرعت شدیدتر شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Done in agreement with a rule, plan or instruction.
example: The appeal was heard in accordance with the published procedure.
examplePersian: استمنا طبق رویهٔ منتشرشده رسیدگی شد.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: A waterproof coat made of shiny plastic, worn to keep the rain out.
example: He put on his mackintosh because the rain was coming down heavily.
examplePersian: او بارانی‌اش را پوشید چون باران به‌شدت می‌بارید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To think about something carefully before acting.
persianMeaning: اندیشیدن؛ با دقت در چیزی تأمل کردن
example: She pondered the offer for a full weekend.
examplePersian: او تمام پایان هفته را به اندیشیدن دربارهٔ پیشنهاد گذراند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To reply sharply and quickly to something that someone has said.
example: He retorted that the figures had been published a year earlier.
examplePersian: او تند پاسخ داد که ارقام یک سال زودتر منتشر شده بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To finally give in to pressure, temptation or a stronger force.
example: After weeks of pressure she succumbed and signed the contract.
examplePersian: پس از هفته‌ها فشار، او تسلیم شد و قرارداد را امضا کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The right to live in a property as a tenant.
persianMeaning: اجاره‌نشینی؛ حق سکونت در ملک به‌عنوان مستأجر
example: The tenancy agreement runs for two years from March.
examplePersian: قرارداد اجاره از مارس به مدت دو سال اعتبار دارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Prevent something bad from happening.
example: Quick action averted a major flood in the town.
examplePersian: اقدام سریع جلوی سیل بزرگی را در شهر گرفت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A bulge is a place where something swells out and becomes rounder.
example: Engineers checked the bulge in the pipe before it burst.
examplePersian: مهندسان پیش از ترکیدن لوله، برآمدگی آن را بررسی کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To contradict someone means to say the opposite of what they have said.
example: The later report contradicts the earlier figures completely.
examplePersian: گزارش بعدی به‌طور کامل با ارقام پیشین در تناقض بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To dislike something or someone very strongly.
example: She detests getting up before six in the morning.
examplePersian: او از بیدار شدن پیش از شش صبح بیزار است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To force someone to leave a place they rent.
example: The landlord evicted the family after three months of unpaid rent.
examplePersian: پس از سه ماه اجاره پرداخت‌نشده، صاحبخانه خانواده را بیرون کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Before an event happens, so that you are ready for it.
example: Bookings must be made at least a week in advance of arrival.
examplePersian: رزرو باید دست‌کم یک هفته پیش از ورود انجام شود.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: A small object that is kept in order to remind you of a person, a place, or an event.
example: He kept a worn photograph as a memento of his childhood.
examplePersian: او یک عکس فرسوده را به‌عنوان یادگاری از کودکی‌اش نگه داشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The right to be dealt with, or to speak, before other people.
example: In any dispute, safety comes before cost and takes precedence over profit.
examplePersian: در هر اختلافی ایمنی مقدم است و بر سود اولویت دارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Causing great damage, loss or expense, and likely to destroy something.
example: The storm did ruinous damage to the old roofs.
examplePersian: طوفان خسارت ویرانگری به بام‌های قدیمی وارد کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Travelling faster than the speed of sound in air.
example: The supersonic aircraft crosses the Atlantic in under four hours.
examplePersian: هواپیمای فراصوتی اقیانوس اطلس را در کمتر از چهار ساعت در می‌نورد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: An old system for sending written messages by teleprinter.
persianMeaning: تکس؛ سیستم قدیمی ارسال پیام مکتوب
example: The order was confirmed by telex before the shipment left.
examplePersian: سفارش پیش از خروج محموله با تکس تأیید شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The mark that shows letters have been left out, as in don't.
example: In informal writing, an apostrophe replaces the missing letter in it's.
examplePersian: در نوشتار غیررسمی، آپاستروف جای حرف حذف‌شده در it's را می‌گیرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A black sticky substance used in road surfacing.
example: A layer of bitumen is laid on the road surface.
examplePersian: لایه‌ای از قیر روی سطح جاده ریخته می‌شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To commend something means to praise it strongly, or to recommend it warmly.
example: The report commends the council for its long-term housing plan.
examplePersian: گزارش شورا را به دلیل برنامه بلندمدت مسکنش ستایش می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: کلاهبرداری کردن، مال کسی را از طریق فریب گرفتن
englishDefinition: To take money or property from someone by deceiving them.
example: The accountant defrauded the charity of nearly half its funds.
examplePersian: حسابدار نزدیک به نیمی از وجوه خیریه را از راه فریب برداشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To make a bad situation even worse.
example: The drought exacerbated the problem of food shortages.
examplePersian: خشکسالی مشکل کمبود غذا را بدتر کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Used to say that something is very probable.
example: In all likelihood, the deadline will be extended again.
examplePersian: به احتمال زیاد، مهلت بار دیگر تمدید خواهد شد.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: The state of being married, or the ceremony by which two people become married.
example: Their fifty years of matrimony began in a small village church.
examplePersian: پنجاه سال زندگی مشترک آن‌ها در کلیسای کوچک یک روستا آغاز شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: اطلاعیه رسمی و شرح کامل شرکت برای جذب سرمایه
englishDefinition: A detailed document that describes a company or a plan and invites people to invest.
example: The prospectus warns investors that early returns are unlikely.
examplePersian: اطلاعیه سرمایه‌گذاری به سرمایه‌گذاران هشدار می‌دهد که بازده زودهنگام بعید است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: خزنده، جانور خونسرد مانند مار و لاک‌پشت
englishDefinition: A cold-blooded animal such as a snake, a lizard or a turtle.
example: Most reptile species depend on sunlight for their body heat.
examplePersian: بیشتر گونه‌های خزنده برای گرم شدن بدن به نور خورشید نیاز دارند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To bend the upper body forward and downwards, often to pick something up.
example: He stooped to pick up the keys that he had dropped.
examplePersian: او خم شد تا کلیدهایی را که انداخته بود بردارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A reference book that groups words together by meaning.
example: A good thesaurus helps you avoid repeating the same word.
examplePersian: یک تسه‌لس خوب کمک می‌کند کلمه تکراری به کار نبرید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Fear or worry about what may happen.
example: There was some apprehension about the new policy.
examplePersian: درباره سیاست جدید کمی نگرانی وجود داشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A conservatory is a glass room where people grow plants that need warmth.
example: She grows tomatoes in a small conservatory behind the house.
examplePersian: او در گلخانه کوچکی پشت خانه گوجه می‌کارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Dirty and poorly lit, so that a place looks unpleasant and unwelcoming.
example: The kitchen was so dingy that they would not sit down to eat.
examplePersian: آشپزخانه چنان کهنه و دودگرفته بود که حاضر نشدند برای غذا خوردن بنشینند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To dig a hole in the ground.
example: Archaeologists excavated the site for three summers.
examplePersian: باستان‌شناسان سه تابستان محل را حفاری کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Very near to something, often in a formal or legal sense.
example: The site sits in close proximity to a protected wetland.
examplePersian: این محل در مجاورت یک تالاب حفاظت‌شده قرار دارد.
collocations: in close proximity to the sea
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: To speak in a low quiet voice, or to make a low continuous sound.
example: He murmured a reply that nobody at the back of the hall could hear.
examplePersian: او زمزمه‌کنان جوابی داد که هیچ‌کس در ته سالن نمی‌شنید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A short thin booklet that gives information about a subject.
example: The council printed a pamphlet explaining the new charges.
examplePersian: شورا جزوه‌ای برای توضیح هزینه‌های جدید چاپ کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: بازتوانبخشی کردن و بازگرداندن به کارکرد درست
englishDefinition: To help a person, building or area return to a healthy or useful state.
example: The council spent a million euros on rehabilitating the old mill.
examplePersian: شورا یک میلیون یورو برای بازتوانبخشی کارخانه قدیمی هزینه کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A strong feeling of dislike and disrespect for a person or thing.
example: He spoke of the proposal with open scorn.
examplePersian: او درباره آن پیشنهاد با تحقیر آشکار سخن گفت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To pass a fluid such as blood from one person to another.
persianMeaning: تزریق کردن؛ انتقال مایعی مانند خون از فردی به فرد دیگر
example: She received two units of blood that were transfused overnight.
examplePersian: او دو واحد خون دریافت کرد که در طول شب تزریق شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Absorb information and understand it properly.
example: Newcomers assimilate the local dialect surprisingly quickly.
examplePersian: تازه‌واردها گویش محلی را به‌شکل شگفت‌انگیزی سریع درونی می‌کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Considerate means showing care for other people and how they feel.
example: It was considerate of you to warn me about the delay.
examplePersian: اینکه درباره تأخیر هشدارم دادی ملاحظه‌کارانه بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To break a substance down into simpler parts, often naturally.
example: Fallen leaves decompose quickly in the warm wet air.
examplePersian: برگ‌های ریخته در هوای گرم و مرطوب به‌سرعت تجزیه می‌شوند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Waste matter that leaves the body through the bowels.
example: A small amount of excrement near the path alerted the officers.
examplePersian: مقدار کمی مدفوع در نزدیکی مسیر مأموران را هوشیار کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Used when two things happen or are used together.
example: The drug is used in conjunction with physical therapy.
examplePersian: این دارو همراه با فیزیوتراپی استفاده می‌شود.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: To harm, attack, or interfere with somebody wrongly, especially a child.
example: The report describes how a caretaker molested several children in the home.
examplePersian: گزارش شرح می‌دهد که یک نگهبان چند کودک را در خانه آزار داده است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Very tiny plants and animals that drift freely in the sea.
example: Whales feed almost entirely on plankton.
examplePersian: نهنگ‌ها تقریباً به‌طور کامل از پلانکتون تغذیه می‌کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: عود بیماری یا بازگشت به رفتار نامطلوب گذشته
englishDefinition: A return to a previous bad state of health or behaviour after a period of recovery.
example: Her relapse into depression lasted most of the winter.
examplePersian: عود او به افسردگی بیشتر زمستان طول کشید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Needing a lot of effort and physical energy, often tiring.
example: Strenuous exercise before bed can interfere with sleep quality.
examplePersian: ورزش پرتلاش پیش از خواب می‌تواند کیفیت خواب را مختل کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Using very few words, sometimes in a way that seems abrupt.
persianMeaning: مختصر و بی‌پیرایه؛ گاهی تند و کوتاه
example: His terse reply gave the reporters almost nothing to report.
examplePersian: پاسخ مختصر او تقریباً چیزی برای گزارش به خبرنگاران نداد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Showing regret or saying sorry about something.
example: He was apologetic about arriving so late.
examplePersian: او بابت دیر رسیدن عذرخواه بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Chaste means pure and simple, avoiding physical pleasure, luxury or sexual experience.
example: The monks are expected to lead a chaste and simple life in the monastery.
examplePersian: از راهبان انتظار می‌رود زندگی زاهدانه و ساده‌ای در صومعه داشته باشند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To send a letter, parcel or message, usually as an official action.
example: The documents were despatched to the regional office on Friday.
